records.issue_text: [ADVISORY] @include order(2) is applied to .extra-info-wrapper and order(3) to .panel, but .contents' other flex children (e.g. .title, hamburger) get default order 0, meaning visual order depends on source order plus scattered order values across two files with no order(1) — the ordering invariant is only partially and implicitly enforced. The next contributor adding a child to .contents must reverse-engineer the implicit 0/2/3 ordering spread across header.scss and topic.scss to avoid misplacing their element; reordering work is spread across files with no single source of truth.
records.rationale: The diff makes `.contents` a flex container (`@include flexbox(); @include align-items(center);` in `header.scss`) and assigns an explicit flex order to `.panel` (`@include order(3);`). Separately, `topic.scss` assigns an explicit order to `.extra-info-wrapper` (`@include order(2);`). Nothing in the diff defines order values for other sibling flex items (they will default to order: 0), so the visual ordering becomes a mix of source order plus a few scattered explicit order overrides. records.issue_text: [ADVISORY] `.small-action-desc` padding changed from the fixed `0.5em 0 0.5em 4em` (where 4em matched the avatar column) to `0 1.5%`, making the indent relative to container width instead of the avatar size it visually belongs to. At narrow viewport widths the percentage padding shrinks below the avatar width so the description text underlaps the avatar, while at wide widths the gap grows disproportionately — the alignment invariant between desc and avatar, previously guaranteed by the shared em unit, is now unenforced.
